select B.MENU_ID from SYS_MENU B left join SYS_ROLE_MENU SRM on B.MENU_ID = SRM.MENU_ID where SRM.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND B.TYPE = 'WORK' AND B.DEL_FLAG = 0
AND B.APP_ID = #{currAppId}
and B.MENU_ID not in (select B.PARENT_ID from SYS_MENU B inner join SYS_ROLE_MENU SRM on B.MENU_ID = SRM.MENU_ID and SRM.ROLE_ID = #{roleId})
order by B.PARENT_ID, B.PRIORITY

select distinct B.PERMS from SYS_MENU B left join SYS_ROLE_MENU SRM on B.MENU_ID = SRM.MENU_ID left join SYS_ROLE RO on SRM.ROLE_ID = RO.ROLE_ID left join PUBLIC_GROUP pg on RO.ROLE_ID = pg.ROLE_ID left join USER_RANGE_ORGAN uro on uro.GROUP_ID = pg.GROUP_ID where 1 = 1 and uro.IS_MEMBER = 1 AND B.TYPE = 'WORK' AND B.DEL_FLAG = 0
AND B.APP_ID = #{currAppId}

select distinct B.PERMS from SYS_MENU B left join SYS_ROLE_MENU SRM on B.MENU_ID = SRM.MENU_ID left join SYS_ROLE RO on SRM.ROLE_ID = RO.ROLE_ID left join PUBLIC_GROUP pg on RO.ROLE_ID = pg.ROLE_ID left join USER_RANGE_ORGAN uro on uro.GROUP_ID = pg.GROUP_ID where B.IS_DISABLED = 0 and RO.STATUS = 0 AND B.TYPE = 'WORK' AND B.DEL_FLAG = 0 and uro.IS_MEMBER = 1 and uro.USERL_ID = #{memberId}
AND B.APP_ID = #{currAppId}
select count(1) from SYS_MENU where PARENT_ID = #{parentId} AND DEL_FLAG = 0
mapper.delete: delete from SYS_MENU where PARENT_ID=#{parentId} AND URL_TYPE = 'BUTTON'
mapper.select: SELECT M.MENU_ID, M.PARENT_ID, M.NAME, M.ENAME FROM SYS_MENU M WHERE 1 = 1 AND M.PARENT_ID = #{menuId} AND M.URL_TYPE = 'BUTTON'

select distinct B.ROLE_ID, B.NAME, B.CODE, B.PRIORITY, B.SPARE1, B.IS_REGULAR, B.IS_PUBLIC, B.STATUS, B.CREATE_TIME, B.DESCRIPTION from SYS_ROLE B left join PUBLIC_GROUP pg on B.ROLE_ID = pg.ROLE_ID left join USER_RANGE_ORGAN uro on uro.GROUP_ID = pg.GROUP_ID left join THIRD_MEMBER tm on tm.MEMBER_ID = uro.USREL_ID WHERE B.STATUS = 1 and tm.USERNAME = #{username}
AND B.APP_ID = #{currAppId}

SELECT DISTINCT B.USER_ID,B.MEMBER_ID,B.NICK_NAME,bu.MOBILE FROM THIRD_MEMBER B LEFT JOIN USER_RANGE_ORGAN uro on B.USER_ID = uro.USER_ID LEFT JOIN BASE_USER bu ON B.USER_ID = bu.USER_ID LEFT JOIN BASE_USER_EXT bue ON B.USER_ID = bue.USER_ID WHERE 1=1
and (B.NICK_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bu.USERNAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bu.MOBILE like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bue.RESUME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bue.NICKNAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM USER_RANGE_ORGAN SO WHERE SO.TYPE = 30 AND SO.DEL_FLAG = 0 AND SO.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND SO.ORGAN_ID = #{organId})
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM USER_RANGE_ORGAN SO WHERE SO.TYPE = 30 AND SO.DEL_FLAG = 0 AND SO.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND SO.POSITION_ID = #{positionId})

SELECT B.RELATION_ID,B.ORGAN_ID,B.USER_ID,B.USERL_ID AS MEMBER_ID,tm.NICK_NAME,bu.MOBILE FROM USER_RANGE_ORGAN B LEFT JOIN BASE_USER bu ON B.USER_ID = bu.USER_ID LEFT JOIN BASE_USER_EXT bue ON B.USER_ID = bue.USER_ID LEFT JOIN THIRD_MEMBER tm ON B.USER_ID = tm.USER_ID WHERE B.TYPE = 30 and B.ORGAN_ID = #{organId} AND B.DEL_FLAG =0
and (tm.NICK_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bu.USERNAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bu.MOBILE like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bue.RESUME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bue.NICKNAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')))
ORDER BY B.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT B.RELATION_ID,B.POSITION_ID,B.USER_ID,B.USERL_ID AS MEMBER_ID,tm.NICK_NAME,bu.MOBILE FROM USER_RANGE_ORGAN B LEFT JOIN BASE_USER bu ON B.USER_ID = bu.USER_ID LEFT JOIN BASE_USER_EXT bue ON B.USER_ID = bue.USER_ID LEFT JOIN THIRD_MEMBER tm ON B.USER_ID = tm.USER_ID WHERE B.TYPE = 30 and B.POSITION_ID = #{positionId} AND B.DEL_FLAG =0
and (tm.NICK_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bu.USERNAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bu.MOBILE like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bue.RESUME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')) or bue.NICKNAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%')))
ORDER BY B.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT B.MEMBER_ID, B.USER_ID, B.NICK_NAME AS NAME, B.MOBILE FROM THIRD_MEMBER B LEFT JOIN BASE_USER_EXT bue ON B.USER_ID = bue.USER_ID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT USERL_ID FROM USER_RANGE_ORGAN WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} )A where A.MEMBER_ID = B.MEMBER_ID)
AND (bue.ID_MOBILE = (SELECT HEX(AES_ENCRYPT(#{q}, '${@net.linlan.config.PlatformSecurityConfig@dbKey}'))) OR bue.ID_NUM = (SELECT HEX(AES_ENCRYPT(#{q}, '${@net.linlan.config.PlatformSecurityConfig@dbKey}'))) OR bue.ID_NAME = (SELECT HEX(AES_ENCRYPT(#{q}, '${@net.linlan.config.PlatformSecurityConfig@dbKey}'))))
AND (bue.ID_MOBILE like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{q},'%')) OR bue.ID_NUM like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{q},'%')) OR bue.ID_NAME like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{q},'%')))

SELECT B.MEMBER_ID, B.USER_ID, B.NICK_NAME AS NAME, B.MOBILE FROM THIRD_MEMBER B LEFT JOIN BASE_USER_EXT bue ON B.USER_ID = bue.USER_ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT USERL_ID FROM USER_RANGE_ORGAN WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} )A where A.MEMBER_ID = B.MEMBER_ID)
AND (bue.ID_MOBILE = (SELECT HEX(AES_ENCRYPT(#{q}, '${@net.linlan.config.PlatformSecurityConfig@dbKey}'))) OR bue.ID_NUM = (SELECT HEX(AES_ENCRYPT(#{q}, '${@net.linlan.config.PlatformSecurityConfig@dbKey}'))) OR bue.ID_NAME = (SELECT HEX(AES_ENCRYPT(#{q}, '${@net.linlan.config.PlatformSecurityConfig@dbKey}'))))
AND (bue.ID_MOBILE like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{q},'%')) OR bue.ID_NUM like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{q},'%')) OR bue.ID_NAME like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{q},'%')))
ORDER BY bue.ID_NAME desc
